owns: Rock star OS, Android SDK and device integration
public web core, workflow and fund simulation
public tool contracts, fixtures and release documentation
private cloud services and provider connectors
operator automation, receipts and deployment configuration
upstream implementations of the four vendored Mr. tools

repositories.archiveGate: Confirm that no GitHub Action, deployment, scheduler or local service still targets this repository.

rules: Do not copy credentials, account registries, customer data, receipts or private deployment configuration into the public repository.
Do not create a second implementation of an existing public contract without a parity fixture and an explicit owner.
Keep the four Mr. source snapshots immutable and place Rock star behavior changes in adapters.
Do not use k999ln/vvvv as a runtime, CI, deployment or new-development target.

audit.note: The exact matches are mainly shared UI boilerplate plus the intentional four-tool source snapshot and MIT license. Equal boilerplate does not justify crossing the public/private boundary.
